name: io.github.dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile
title: Agent-Ready Web Profile Gateway
description: Read-only generic MCP gateway for a website that publishes a valid Agent-Ready Web Profile. The gateway exposes only profile-declared resources and retrieval indexes.

environmentVariables.name: ARWP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS URL or local path of the Agent-Ready Web Profile that configures the read-only gateway.

environmentVariables.name: ARWP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated additional HTTPS origins that declared resources may use.
